items.name: Rakim
items.line: pioneer in Hip-Hop

items.name: Miles Davis
items.line: dawntreader in experimental sound and radical authenticity

items.name: Andrei Tarkovsky
items.line: filmmaker and luminous seeker, "Modern mass culture, aimed at the 'consumer', the civilisation of prosthetics, is crippling people's souls, setting up barriers between man and the crucial questions of his existence, his consciousness of himself as a spiritual being." - rest in peace.

items.name: Michael Jackson
items.line: we love you and we haven't forgotten you

items.name: Mike Tyson
items.line: radical authentic human, God bless you

items.name: Anthony Burgess
items.line: genius English novelist who travelled the world and wrote in a style that is literally incomparable and the epitome of art

items.name: W. B. Yeats
items.line: Irish poet and seeker, a firework of a human being who existed and whose words still resonate today

items.name: Nina Simone
items.line: never-endingly and supra-sentimentally, always...

items.name: Akira Kurosawa
items.line: one of the greatest filmmakers and most clear-minded, clear-seeing artists there ever was, you are missed. Read his half-finished autobiography if you can.

items.name: Bob Marley
items.line: the one whose beautiful voice/spirit still dance with us in the world today, represented a God-first mentality and lived an authentic life. Read his wife's book about their early life together, it's beautiful.

items.name: Leo Tolstoy
items.line: giant of Russian literature, progressive believer and passionate advocate for the human connection with God. Afghans/Muslims should definitely read his last great novel Hadji Murat.

items.name: Sun Ra
items.line: the world needed and needs reminders, some people give their entire life to reminding humanity, we love you.

items.name: Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan
items.line: luminary, seeker, Qawwali master and Sufi, there can be only one Nusrat, we love you and miss you.

items.name: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
items.line: a great of Russian literature, proof that sometimes God gives certain people amazing lives and gives them an equal gift for expression to share with the world, touched and forever loved.

items.name: Don Cherry
items.line: jazz pioneer, seeker and traveler, thank you.

items.name: Henry Ossawa Tanner
items.line: gifted artist, painter and believer, his works remain (or even increase) modern despite their age, African American pioneer artist.

items.name: Freddie Mercury
items.line: a great artist who was a huge part of my early life and who my dad once sat next to on the London to Brighton when I was a kid. Every true artist teaches, Freddie was such an artist, and as Tarkovsky once said, 'even the Artist's mistakes are interesting.'

items.name: Bob Dylan
items.line: the giant soul in a whisper quiet form, keenest observer, believer, artist; did not live his life just for fame, sought God with sincerity.

items.name: W. Somerset Maugham
items.line: maybe my favourite novelist, a clear-eyed man whose expression and clarity of thought and observation will never be matched.

items.name: Joni Mitchell
items.line: one of my biggest early inspirations, giant artist, gave herself to the gift.

items.name: Eric Burdon
items.line: few have delved into the greatness of this man's spirit, Newcastle to the entire world, God bless you Eric, rock IN eternally.

items.name: George Harrison
items.line: greatest is the quietest. Dear One, we love you George, may you travel long, long, long, may we all be together again in the Cosmic Empire.

items.name: Hermann Hesse
items.line: read his poems not just his novels, God bless you sir.

items.name: David Lynch
items.line: we miss you more, you are here, we see you often.

items.name: Ernest Hemingway
items.line: giant of American literature for good reason, works still read as modern, anti-war and rightly guided, may God have mercy on your soul.

items.name: John Keats
items.line: we studied you in school and I have never forgotten you, in England I saw you often, you are always somewhere around.

items.name: William Carlos Williams
items.line: one of my favourite poets, a full-time doctor as well as a great artist, whose works still bring with them the fresh breeze of the East Coast to me every time, try reading Sour Grapes.

items.name: Daniel Abdal-Hayy Moore
items.line: a friend in the art / spirit path, the man who gave me my first ever public poetry reading spotlight at RADA in London; Daniel was one of the last great beat poets and the most enduring spiritually, rest in peace, sweet soul.

items.name: Tarjei Vesaas
items.line: one of my favourite novelists, authentic, found untold greatness in the smallest specks of this life.

items.name: Kurt Vonnegut
items.line: great novelist and inspiration, survivor of war who knew its folly, a great connector for writers, a writer's writer.

items.name: John Coltrane
items.line: whirling spirit never lost calm traveler who stumbled upon the perfect moment and found the love supreme.

items.name: Pharoah Sanders
items.line: great musician and huge influence, he never stopped, his entire life was his art. Rest in peace, uncle.

items.name: Prince
items.line: my connection to you remains quivering and raw and I love you.

items.name: Paul Gauguin
items.line: great artist and painter and seeker, a huge influence in my 20s, a brave man who gave his all.

items.name: Mos Def
items.line: Hip-Hop icon, lent his support to Astralab when we needed it - I came of age with his first few albums, a great artist, you always have my heart, big brother, salaam alaikum wrb.

items.name: Ishmael Butler
items.line: legendary statue of Poetry, Music, Hip-Hop. If there is a great future still ahead, then more artists will be studying and discovering Ish in it.

items.name: Liam Gallagher
items.line: rock on you mad bastard I love you.

items.name: Jim Morrison
items.line: I made a promise to you and I am doing my best to keep it.

items.name: Luciano Pavarotti
items.line: I sang his songs in bed as a child, I still sing them, it is obvious from his voice that he loved life.

items.name: Emily Dickinson
items.line: great poet of New England who was a huge early inspiration, brave soul whose poetry is as fresh today as ever.

items.name: Russell Jones aka ODB
items.line: we miss you and your free spirit.

items.name: Henri Matisse
items.line: great painter and huge influence, an artist who was as calm and quiet as he was great and gifted.

items.name: Ryuichi Sakamoto
items.line: iconic Japanese musician and artist, huge early influence, thank you for what you gave us.

items.name: Muslimgauze
items.line: pioneering political artist who I was deeply into in the 90s and whose work endures to this day. You are remembered.

items.name: RZA
items.line: keep traveling deeper, we love you

items.name: Kate Bush
items.line: vivid spirit in a cyclone of love, thank you for all you have given us.

items.name: Pablo Picasso
items.line: great artist, powerful artist, inspiration.

items.name: Donovan
items.line: happy man, we love you

items.name: Søren Kierkegaard
items.line: great philosopher with a unique / sharp mind whose writings are interesting thought experiments to exercise the brain.

items.name: Julia Kristeva
items.line: a great philosopher I inherited from my mother's love of her.

items.name: Octavio Paz
items.line: giant of Mexican literature, poetry and prose, one of my biggest influences and someone I love in a way I can never understand.

items.name: Cody ChesnuTT
items.line: great artist with integrity, you are revered for what you do and how you do it, stay on and in, brother.

items.name: Melle Mel
items.line: early Hip-Hop pioneer, powerhouse and one of the first gifted storytellers of Hip-Hop.

items.name: Socrates
items.line: touched by the Divine, everyone really should try to read his Apology, Crito, Phaedo once in their life.

items.name: Marvin Gaye
items.line: man you were everything to me, thank you

items.name: Marlon Brando
items.line: one of the very few well-known actors who had genuine artistic integrity and who artists today can learn from.

items.name: Brian Eno
items.line: early ambient influence and ongoing inspiration
items.bornNote: thank you for everything you've done and do, Brian
